issue.title: Master Gate red: attachment-lifecycle audit site, repositories schema wording, and CLI completion snapshot drift after bead-attachments GA
issue.description:
Three whole-repo contract tests fail deterministically on clean sase master 63bde575f0 (reproduced in isolation with no local changes via `git stash`) and are also red in Master Gate run 36714816529 at d6f2b237a6. All three trace to the bead-attachments work from epic sase-1ck, which is now closed.

1. `tests/test_agent_artifact_directory_operation_audit.py::test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed`: an unreviewed artifact-directory operation site `src/sase/bead/attachments/lifecycle.py:quarantine_local_object`, introduced by ee1620e1b9 (feat(bead): implement attachment lifecycle). The fix is to review the site and add it to the audit's reviewed set, or route it through the reviewed helper.
2. `tests/test_config_schema_repositories.py::test_config_schema_documents_intrinsic_agents_sidecar_contract`: the schema description for repositories now reads "... agents and attachments-private roles are explicitly accessible only at ~/.sase/projects/<project_key>/repos/<role>" and no longer contains the literal `~/.sase/projects/<project_key>/repos/agents` that the test asserts. The wording changed with the attachments-private sidecar role (e300173faf and follow-ups). Decide whether the test or the schema text is authoritative, then update the other.
3. `tests/completion/test_snapshot.py::test_checked_in_snapshot_has_no_drift` and `::test_current_structural_view_matches_checked_in_snapshot`: the sase CLI completion spec is out of sync with the argparse tree, most likely from the new `sase bead attachment ...` subcommands. Regenerate the checked-in snapshot with the repo's refresh recipe, then review the diff.

Note: the relaunched sase-1ck landing (sase-1ck note #13, base d6f2b237a6) had not yet committed when this task was filed. Re-check each node on current master before fixing, because that landing may already have resolved some of them.
